clues.text: This city stands in the north of a long land in the south east of Asia. Lakes rest in its heart, and a flat river delta spreads around it.
clues.narrowing: Puts the player in the north of a long south-east Asian land, on a river delta.

source.quote: It hosts the Imperial Citadel of Thăng Long, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, Hoàn Kiếm Lake, West Lake

clues.text: This city has four clear seasons in the year. Winter winds from the north east bring cool, dry air, while summers are hot, wet, and humid.
clues.narrowing: Rules out the steady tropics; keeps a four-season city ruled by monsoon winds.

source.quote: Winters, from December to February, are characterized as being cool by the northeast monsoon, giving Hanoi a dry winter.

clues.text: In the year 1010 an emperor made this place his capital. He named the city for a dragon he said he saw rise from the river.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals founded in 1010 and named for a rising dragon.

source.quote: emperor Lý Thái Tổ established the capital of the imperial nation Đại Việt in what would later become central Hanoi, naming the city Thăng Long ([tʰɐŋ loŋ], 'ascending dragon').

clues.text: This northern city holds the top job in its land. It rules the nation, even though a larger city stands far to the south.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: the capital is the second city, not the biggest, which lies far south.

source.quote: is the capital and second-most populous centrally-governed city of Vietnam.

clues.text: This city hosts the embassies of many lands and the chief office of the army of Vietnam. The nation's government sits here.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: Vietnam's government and army chiefs sit in this city.

source.quote: It hosts 83 foreign embassies, the headquarters of the Vietnam People's Army (VPA)

reveal.blurb: An emperor made this place his capital in 1010 and named it for a rising dragon. The capital later moved away, then came back, and in 1976 the city led a land made whole again. Its lakes and old citadel still draw crowds today. Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam.
